<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C11H14O4), DBE (5), the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl at ~168 ppm, six aromatic carbons, an O‑attached aliphatic carbon at ~58 ppm, two equivalent aliphatic carbons at ~36 ppm, and one methyl carbon at ~26 ppm), the molecule can be viewed as an aromatic benzoic‑type fragment that is esterified to an aliphatic chain and bears two methoxy substituents. The logical fragments that can be joined to rebuild the whole structure are:

1. the aromatic benzoic‑acid fragment – `c1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O`
2. a methoxy fragment – `CO`
3. a second methoxy fragment – `CO`
4. a propoxy fragment (the O‑linked propyl chain) – `CCCO`

These SMILES strings represent the pieces that, when connected (ester linkage and O‑methyl attachments), give a molecule matching the given data.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O', 'CO', 'CO', 'CCCO']</final_answer>
